Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) Stock Price Declined While Water Island Capital LLC Cut by $108.20 Million Its Position Posted by Pete Kolinski 35 pm
Water Island Capital Llc decreased its stake in Nxp Semiconductors N V (NXPI) by 42.16% based on its latest 2018Q2 regulatory filing with the SEC. Water Island Capital Llc sold 992,665 shares as the company’s stock declined 20.32% while stock markets rallied. The hedge fund held 1.36M shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2018Q2, valued at $148.81M, down from 2.35 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Water Island Capital Llc who had been investing in Nxp Semiconductors N V for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $23.62B market cap company. The stock decreased 2.57% or $2.11 during the last trading session, reaching $79.94. About 611,606 shares traded. NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) has declined 21.26% downtrending. It has underperformed by 36.88% the S&P500.
Water Island Capital Llc, which manages about $3.48 billion and $1.84B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Pinnacle Entmt Inc New by 318,877 shares to 974,761 shares, valued at $32.88 million in 2018Q2, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Kindred Healthcare Inc (NYSE:KND) by 526,733 shares in the quarter, for a total of 3.60 million shares, and has risen its stake in Rsp Permian Inc (NYSE:RSPP).
Analysts await NXP Semiconductors N.V. (NASDAQ:NXPI) to report earnings on February, 6. They expect $1.77 EPS, down 42.16 % or $1.29 from last year’s $3.06 per share. NXPI’s profit will be $523.03M for 11.29 P/E if the $1.77 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.81 actual EPS reported by NXP Semiconductors N.V. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.21 % negative EPS growth.
